title: The Feed's streak and Zap numbers sit as one quiet line of small chips instead of four display-size numerals

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: minimize the streak stats, don't display them so boldly, clear this header up.

detail: The standing row under the Feed greeting (.fa-stats: streak, Zaps, count, rank) drops from display-size numerals and a 40px glass rank pill to small outlined chips, number and label side by side at the body size, 16px under the greeting; the pressed chip shows by a stronger outline instead of an underline. The rail's Stats & streaks box quiets with it: the streak figure from 34px to 22px, its icon in the accent, the tile figures a step smaller. Markup unchanged; hand-kept members-a.css and members-shell.css only.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-a.css','utf8');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8');const bad=[];const i=a.indexOf('SCAN-908');const b=i<0?'':a.slice(i);if(!/\.fa-stat\{flex-direction:row/.test(b))bad.push('the standing stats are not inline chips');if(!/\.fa-stat-n \.num\{font:500 var\(--fq-text-body-s\)/.test(b))bad.push('the stat numerals are still display size');if(!/SCAN-908[\s\S]*fqm-stats-num b\{font-size:22px/.test(s))bad.push('the rail streak numeral is still 34px');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-908: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
